decisions.reason: Selecting base 10 blocks as the third visual object type does not change the review sequence or the requirement for three questions per level.
The visual representation selected for type 3 does not alter gradual progression or curriculum-block-based level splitting.
Base 10 blocks specify a visual object representation and do not resolve or change curriculum coverage, block alignment, or the existing Grade 5 ambiguity.
The new visual object type does not change how questions applicable to multiple levels are copied or assigned.
The visual object selection neither resumes nor changes the deferred C# random-generator requirement.
